insert.tables.table.grid-picker.note: U:slate/insert: OneNote's grid picker (hover sizes the table, a click inserts it) is drawn by the shell (src/shell/ribbon/TableGridPicker.tsx) and runs insert.table with the hovered rows and columns; the spec's placeholder args are not command args.

insert.images.online-pictures.note: U:slate/insert: hidden. Online Pictures searches Bing's image catalogue, a Microsoft online service the app does not have.

insert.media.online-video.note: U:slate/insert: hidden. Embeds a web video player from a link; the app has no web views on a page.

insert.loop-components.loop-components.note: U:slate/insert: hidden. Loop components are live shared objects of Microsoft 365; the app has no Loop service.

insert.forms.forms.note: U:slate/insert: hidden. Forms creates a Microsoft Forms survey online; the app has no Forms service.

insert.symbols.equation.ink-equation.note: U:slate/insert: hidden. Ink Equation recognises handwriting with Microsoft's math input recogniser; the app has none. Type equations in linear format instead.

dialog.link.note: U:slate/insert: the location list is this notebook (sections in their groups with their pages), filtered by the search box; the label says so instead of naming OneNote.

dialog.insert-picture.note: U:slate/insert: OneNote opens the system Open dialog straight from Insert > Pictures (studio:image, PNG and JPEG up to 5 MB); there is no dialog of the app's own.

dialog.insert-file.note: U:slate/insert: File Attachment and File Printout open the system Open dialog (studio:pick-document, any file up to 30 MB, 25 MB on a page); the upload-to-cloud choice needs OneDrive, which the app does not have.

text.insert.label: Type Text
text.insert.summary: Write text on the page at the caret or over the selection; with no caret, after the last paragraph of the page's last note container (a new one when there is none). Used by automation and tests to enter text.
